answer: River-dune relic decay bond: each identity locks a 70-credit bond on one relic from a river dune, on a decay clock. It sheds 7 an epoch and dies in 10 unless topped up; auditors check relics against the table, reused or over-aged ones burn. One fake costs 70 plus 7 per epoch; 1,000 cost 70,000 and 7,000 per epoch, 140,000 over 10 epochs against a 40,000 pool. A rented relic's age never matches a fresh clock. An honest agent pays 70 once.
